supplements.title: Current landscape and therapeutic prospects of indole hybrids for prostate cancer treatment: A mini-review.
supplements.summary: Indole hybrid compounds show promise for treating prostate cancer by targeting multiple pathways and overcoming drug resistance.

supplements.title: Design, synthesis, and evaluation of unsymmetrical trifluoromethyl-containing bisindolylmethane derivatives inducing endoplasmic reticulum stress in human lung adenocarcinoma.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a new compound (5b) that kills lung cancer cells by triggering stress in the endoplasmic reticulum, showing superior effectiveness compared to existing treatments.

supplements.title: Design, semisynthesis, and anti-inflammatory activity evaluation of a terphenyllin compound library for alleviating ulcerative colitis.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a terphenyllin derivative (c13) that effectively reduces inflammation in ulcerative colitis, potentially lowering cancer risk.

supplements.title: Tanshinone IIA derivatives inhibits colorectal cancer growth by targeting pyruvate kinase M2.
supplements.summary: A new Tanshinone IIA derivative slows colorectal cancer growth by activating a key enzyme and blocking cancer cell signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Discovery of novel and potent harringtonine derivative P2 via systematic structure-activity Optimization: Semi-Synthesis, anti-leukemia activity, and mechanism study.
supplements.summary: Researchers created a new leukemia drug candidate (P2) that is ten times more potent than existing treatments by blocking protein production in cancer cells.

supplements.title: Epigenetically regulated pancreatic GABA-somatostatin signaling underlies gestational diabetes-induced glucose intolerance in offspring.
supplements.summary: Maternal diabetes reduces pancreatic GABA levels in offspring, impairing insulin function; GABA supplementation restores normal glucose metabolism.

supplements.title: Merremia tridentata ethyl acetate extract suppresses HepG2 hepatocellular carcinoma cell proliferation via PCNA downregulation and mitochondria-mediated apoptosis.
supplements.summary: A plant extract from Merremia tridentata kills liver cancer cells by triggering programmed cell death and stopping cell growth.

supplements.title: Effectiveness of Qingdu Suppository on Persistent HR-HPV and Associated Factors: A Retrospective Study.
supplements.summary: Qingdu Suppository treatment helped clear persistent HPV infections in cervical cancer patients, with certain factors predicting better treatment success.

supplements.title: Integrated PASS Prediction, Molecular Networking-Guided Isolation, and Quantum Mechanics-Assisted Structure Elucidation Enable the Discovery of Cytotoxic Dimeric Sesquiterpenoids from Inulae Flos.
supplements.summary: Researchers discovered seven dimeric sesquiterpenoids from Inulae Flos that showed significant cytotoxicity against liver and prostate cancer cells using data-science techniques.

supplements.title: Integrated Metabolomic and Transcriptomic Analyses Elucidate Phenolic Acid Diversity and Their Antioxidant and Functional Associations in Ocimum Species.
supplements.summary: Ocimum plants produce diverse phenolic acids that enhance antioxidant defenses and may target cancer-related proteins like AKT1 and EGFR.

supplements.title: The role of prehabilitation in improving brain health and cognition after chemotherapy in patients with colorectal cancer: Study protocol of the Chemo Brain Prehab Project.
supplements.summary: Researchers are testing whether exercise and training before chemotherapy can prevent memory and thinking problems in colorectal cancer patients.

supplements.title: Evaluation of the anticancer effects of ellagic acid and cisplatin in cisplatin-sensitive and -resistant MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Ellagic acid combined with cisplatin effectively kills breast cancer cells by reducing drug resistance and triggering cell death mechanisms.

supplements.title: UHRF1 as an epigenetic therapeutic target in Cancer.
supplements.summary: UHRF1 protein, overexpressed in many cancers, is a promising drug target that could be inhibited to stop tumor growth and restore treatment sensitivity.

supplements.title: Herbacetin alleviates acute doxorubicin cardiotoxicity via regulating the ERK1/2-FOXO3a signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Herbacetin protects heart cells from doxorubicin chemotherapy damage by activating a specific cellular signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Vitamin D inhibits the development of colorectal cancer cells by regulating the gut microbiota and immune microenvironment using JAKSTAT signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Vitamin D reduces colorectal cancer cell growth by improving gut bacteria and immune response through a specific signaling pathway.

off_label.title: MondoA mediates transcriptional coordination between the MYC network and the integrated stress response in pancreatic cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking MondoA protein kills pancreatic cancer cells with high MYC levels by disrupting stress response pathways and triggering cell death.

off_label.title: Finerenone in Type 1 Diabetes and Chronic Kidney Disease.
off_label.summary: Researchers are testing whether finerenone, a kidney-protective drug, works safely and effectively for type 1 diabetes patients with kidney disease.

off_label.title: Ion-Exchange and Energy-Stress Strategies Amplified Dual-Site Nanozyme-Mediated Ferroptosis/Pyroptosis Inhibition for Neuroprotection.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a nano-particle treatment that crosses the brain barrier to prevent cell death and reduce inflammation after brain hemorrhage.

off_label.title: Immunotherapy Inhibits Tumor Cholesterol Synthesis via the IFNγ-IRF1-SREBF2 Axis.
off_label.summary: Immunotherapy blocks cholesterol production in cancer cells through an immune signaling pathway, slowing tumor growth.

off_label.title: Cardioprotective effects of prophylactic ACE inhibitors in anthracycline-induced cardiotoxicity: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials.
off_label.summary: ACE inhibitors help prevent heart damage in cancer patients receiving anthracycline chemotherapy, particularly those also taking trastuzumab.

off_label.title: Targeting the RXR Pathway for the Prevention of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
off_label.summary: RXR agonist drugs delayed or prevented triple-negative breast cancer development in mouse models with minimal side effects.

off_label.title: The multifunctional RNA helicase DDX39A drives glioblastoma progression by modulating WISP1 alternative splicing that induces an immunosuppressive macrophage polarization.
off_label.summary: DDX39A protein drives glioblastoma growth by suppressing immune cells; blocking it with a drug slows tumor progression.

off_label.title: Ribosomal profiling of the geniculate ganglion identifies the receptor ALK as critical for the development and maintenance of oral sensory neurons.
off_label.summary: ALK protein is critical for developing and maintaining taste buds and oral sensory neurons; ALK inhibitors used to treat lung cancer cause taste loss.

off_label.title: Pharmacokinetics of intra-articular delivery of flavopiridol-loaded microparticles reveal sustained effects in Lewis rats.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a sustained-release injection of flavopiridol for osteoarthritis that maintains therapeutic levels in affected joints.

off_label.title: CDK8/CDK19 inhibition restores T-cell homeostasis in primary immune thrombocytopenia.
off_label.summary: CDK8/CDK19 inhibition converts immune cells into regulatory T cells, restoring balance and reducing symptoms in immune thrombocytopenia.

off_label.title: Dasatinib boosts γδ T cell expansion and memory phenotypes with enhanced antitumor immunity.
off_label.summary: Dasatinib drug treatment enhances expansion and anti-tumor function of gamma-delta T cells against glioblastoma and breast cancer.

off_label.title: Empagliflozin and intermittent fasting as a strategy to mitigate anthracycline-induced cardiotoxicity.
off_label.summary: Empagliflozin and intermittent fasting each reduce heart damage from doxorubicin chemotherapy by protecting heart cells and reducing inflammation.

off_label.title: cGAS-STING signaling in pollution-induced toxicity: mechanism and relieving medication.
off_label.summary: Environmental pollutants activate a cellular alarm pathway (cGAS-STING) causing inflammation and disease; blocking it may reduce toxicity.

off_label.title: Liposomal Amodiaquine for Localized Therapy of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC).
off_label.summary: Inhalable liposomes containing an anti-malarial drug showed enhanced effectiveness against lung cancer cells in laboratory studies.

off_label.title: Post-translational modifications of triosephosphate isomerase reveal metabolic vulnerabilities in T-ALL: effect of combining dichloroacetic acid and the PPI rabeprazole.
off_label.summary: Combining rabeprazole and dichloroacetic acid selectively kills T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells by targeting a modified metabolic enzyme while sparing normal cells.

biomarkers.title: Optimizing protocols for microRNA profiling of infant and toddler stool.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified optimal methods for preserving and extracting genetic material from infant stool samples for microRNA analysis.

biomarkers.title: The Diagnostic Value of PET/CT and MRI in Head and Neck Cancer of Unknown Primary.
biomarkers.summary: PET/CT and MRI imaging help doctors identify the original source of head and neck cancer when the primary tumor location is unknown.

biomarkers.title: Extracellular heme:DNA complexes promote oxidative stress and inflammation during lupus-associated hemolysis.
biomarkers.summary: Heme and free DNA released during hemolysis combine to trigger inflammation and tissue damage in lupus disease.

biomarkers.title: Neutralization of acyl-CoA-binding protein attenuates glucocorticoid-mediated suppression of cancer immunosurveillance.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking a protein called ACBP/DBI restores cancer-fighting immune responses suppressed by steroids in breast, lung, and skin cancers.

biomarkers.title: MondoA mediates transcriptional coordination between the MYC network and the integrated stress response in pancreatic cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking MondoA protein kills pancreatic cancer cells with high MYC levels by disrupting stress response pathways and triggering cell death.

biomarkers.title: Effects of Radiotherapy in Normal Tissue.
biomarkers.summary: Modern radiotherapy improves tumor control while reducing side effects through better imaging, planning, and dose delivery techniques.

biomarkers.title: DLST mediates the malignant progression of osteosarcoma cells by regulating the p38 MAPK signaling pathway.
biomarkers.summary: DLST protein drives osteosarcoma cancer growth by activating the p38 MAPK signaling pathway.

biomarkers.title: ALB suppresses epithelial-mesenchymal transition and glycolysis via SPARC regulation in metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified that ALB protein suppresses tumor spread and energy metabolism in metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinoma through SPARC regulation.

biomarkers.title: Mechanistic insights and therapeutic potential of E3 ubiquitin ligases in gastric cancer development.
biomarkers.summary: E3 ubiquitin ligases control protein breakdown and offer new therapeutic targets for treating gastric cancer.

biomarkers.title: Crohn's disease under single-cell map: from INFLARE metaplastic cells to rare immune cell subpopulations.
biomarkers.summary: Single-cell sequencing reveals novel immune cell subsets in Crohn's disease, offering potential new therapeutic targets.

biomarkers.title: Current landscape and therapeutic prospects of indole hybrids for prostate cancer treatment: A mini-review.
biomarkers.summary: Indole hybrid compounds show promise for treating prostate cancer by targeting multiple pathways and overcoming drug resistance.

biomarkers.title: Discover of a highly effective covalent inhibitor of CDK6 for triple-negative breast cancer treatment.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed compound C32, a potent CDK6 inhibitor that is 200-fold more effective than current drugs against triple-negative breast cancer cells.

biomarkers.title: Discovery of WWZ-11-098: a rigid and selective CDK6 degrader.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered WWZ-11-098, a selective CDK6 degrader that effectively stops blood cancer cell growth without harming other proteins.

biomarkers.title: Preclinical evaluation of 68Ga-labeled acetazolamide derivatives as radiotracers targeting carbonic anhydrase IX in clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a new PET imaging tracer targeting a kidney cancer protein, showing promise for detecting clear-cell renal carcinoma.

biomarkers.title: Discovery of an orally bioavailable pyridone-based BRD4 inhibitor with potent antitumor efficacy in colorectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered an oral drug (H5) that inhibits BRD4 protein, effectively shrinking colorectal cancer tumors in mice with minimal side effects.

trials.title: Effects of Radiotherapy in Normal Tissue.
trials.summary: Modern radiotherapy improves tumor control while reducing side effects through better imaging, planning, and dose delivery techniques.

trials.title: Finerenone in Type 1 Diabetes and Chronic Kidney Disease.
trials.summary: Researchers are testing whether finerenone, a kidney-protective drug, works safely and effectively for type 1 diabetes patients with kidney disease.

trials.title: The efficacy of combination therapy versus monotherapy in patients with glioblastoma with abnormal epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) genes, a systematic review and network meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Combination therapies with targeted drugs plus temozolomide outperform single-drug treatments in glioblastoma patients with abnormal EGFR genes.

trials.title: Advances in novel modification strategies for enhancing the tumor tissue specificity of PROTACs.
trials.summary: Scientists developed strategies to make PROTACs, a cancer-fighting drug technology, accumulate specifically in tumors while reducing harmful side effects.

trials.title: Prognostic Significance of Circulating Tumor Cells in Patients with Esophageal Cancer Who Attained Pathological Complete Response after Neoadjuvant Therapy.
trials.summary: Circulating tumor cells can identify esophageal cancer patients at high recurrence risk despite achieving complete tumor response after chemotherapy.

trials.title: Izalontamab Brengitecan in Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer With Actionable Genomic Alterations Outside of Classical EGFR Mutations: A Phase Ib Study.
trials.summary: A new drug combination shows promise treating lung cancer patients with specific genetic mutations beyond standard EGFR changes.

trials.title: Trastuzumab Rezetecan in Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2-Expressing Advanced Gastric Cancer or Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma and Colorectal Cancer: A Multicenter, Open-Label, Phase I Trial.
trials.summary: A new targeted drug called trastuzumab rezetecan showed promise against advanced gastric, junction, and colorectal cancers with specific protein markers.

trials.title: Low-dose chemotherapy remodels hepatic immune landscape and potentiates anti-tumor response to immune checkpoint blockade in cholangiocarcinoma.
trials.summary: Low-dose chemotherapy combined with immunotherapy improves anti-tumor immunity and reduces toxicity in cholangiocarcinoma patients.

trials.title: Engineering CAR T cells to secrete VEGF-neutralizing scFvs enhances antitumor activity against solid tumors.
trials.summary: CAR T cells engineered to neutralize VEGF show enhanced effectiveness against solid tumors like ovarian cancer and glioma.

trials.title: Anti-HPA-1a Fetal-Neonatal AlloImmune Thrombocytopenia: Reframing Diagnostics, Pathophysiology, and Management.
trials.summary: Maternal antibodies against fetal platelets cause dangerous bleeding in newborns; new tests and treatments improve outcomes and pregnancy planning.

trials.title: How I Treat HLH-Like Toxicities Following Immune Effector Cell Therapy.
trials.summary: Doctors can better treat dangerous inflammatory complications from CAR T-cell cancer therapy by distinguishing between two HLH-like syndromes and intervening early.

trials.title: Myeloid/Lymphoid Neoplasms with FGFR1 Rearrangement and Pemigatinib.
trials.summary: Pemigatinib, a targeted drug blocking FGFR1, shows remarkable effectiveness in treating rare myeloid/lymphoid blood cancers with FGFR1 mutations.

trials.title: Prognostic Factors and Progression Biomarkers in AL Amyloidosis: Mapping Current Knowledge and Critical Gaps.
trials.summary: Newer AL amyloidosis treatments achieve better survival, but prognostic models need updating to identify patients needing additional interventions.

trials.title: Comparison of first-line cetuximab and panitumumab plus doublet chemotherapies for left-sided colorectal cancer: a multicenter real-world observational study by the Japanese Society for Cancer of the Colon and Rectum.
trials.summary: Study compares two antibody drugs combined with chemotherapy for treating advanced left-sided colorectal cancer.

trials.title: Cost-effectiveness analysis of immune checkpoint inhibitors versus platinum-based doublet chemotherapy in the first-line treatment of advanced non-small-cell lung cancer with High PD-L1 expression in Japan.
trials.summary: Immune checkpoint inhibitors are more cost-effective than chemotherapy for treating advanced lung cancer with high PD-L1 expression in Japan.
